commit.message:
feat(workspaces): move-items IPC, group runner and the item lock on every writer (NIW2-600)

- workspaces:move-items runs N single moves one after another inside the
  workspace gate, holds the switch lock ("moving") from the first item to
  the last, reports "n of N" progress, and lets Stop finish the item in
  flight; workspaces:cancel-move stops it.
- Interrupted moves heal at startup and before each group.
- Session saves, renames, deletes and screenshot overwrites take the item
  lock; a session save queued behind a move is refused with item-moved.
- Drags are recorded in a ledger so a move waits 10 s after a drag and
  removes the item's drag folder first.
- Workspaces carry their volume (stat.dev) so "Move to" can say whether a
  move is instant or copies; create and add accept activate: false for
  "Move to ▸ New workspace…".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(workspaces): Move to in the editors, the item page and the Library (NIW2-600)

- "IN · Work ▾" chip at the right of the app header in the screenshot and
  video editors and on the item page: "belongs here", then "Move to" with
  the cost of each destination (same drive · instant, other drive · copies,
  not connected). Locked with the reason while recording, exporting or
  moving. Moving closes the editor first, through the same flush and leave
  guard as a workspace switch.
- Library: a "⋯" menu on every card and row, and a select mode with
  checkboxes, shift-click ranges in the order on screen, and a bottom bar
  "N selected · Move to ▸" with "Moving 3 of 12…" and Stop. Every existing
  filter stays; changing one clears the selection; what failed stays
  selected.
- Moving a recording with exports asks "Move all N+1" or "Move only the
  recording"; the result toast lists what moved, what stayed and why, and
  offers Switch.
- "Move to ▸ New workspace…" (when no other workspace exists) reuses the
  New workspace dialog and creates or adopts the folder without switching.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(workspaces): part 2 in ADR 0033, the spec and the backlog (NIW2-600)

ADR 0033 is amended where the code had to differ: a collision takes the
" (2)" tail of ADR 0035, the same-volume "rename" is a hard link plus the
source's unlink (a link never replaces), and the webcam track moves with
the item. Implementation notes say what part 2 does not cover yet: synced
folders, cloud-only items, the cloud step and a screen for quarantined
moves.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): healing a move never deletes a source that is no longer the moved item (NIW2-600)

Roll-forward removed the source media and companions whenever the source
stem was occupied, and wiped the whole .kaipu/drag folder. Now it deletes
only while the source record is the moved item's, the media matches the
journal and the edit project is the one that was copied; otherwise it
quarantines. A media file that cannot be removed keeps the journal and the
record. A failing post-commit heal still reports the move as done, with the
real mode. The item id is validated before the lock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): a group move names its real failure; no tags minted past the cap (NIW2-600)

A thrown group move was always reported as stale. It now maps a stale
window, a maintenance run and anything else to stale, maintenance and io.
A rejected device-id read is no longer cached for the rest of the process.
ensureByName stops minting at the per-item cap. The doc on skipped now
matches what the code puts there.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(library): the Move to menu works from the keyboard (NIW2-600)

A key pressed on the ⋯ button or a menu item bubbled to the card or row and
opened (or checked) the item. The card and row now ignore keys that did not
start on themselves. In select mode they expose aria-pressed and
aria-disabled, and the menu takes focus on open and gives it back on close.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): honest move results: Stop, export order, IPC failure (NIW2-600)

A Stop before the first move finished read 'Moved 0 items'; it now says
nothing moved. Exports go in the order they have on screen, not reversed.
A rejected IPC call is reported as an I/O failure, not as a changed
workspace.

fix(workspaces): a lost move reply says the result is unknown (NIW2-600)

The renderer cannot know whether main moved part of the group before the
reply was lost, so it no longer claims the originals are untouched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

merge: part 1b (Change folder…) into part 2 (Move to) (NIW2-600)

Keeps both behaviours. Part 2 restores the pointer to "Move to" in the
empty-folder refusal that part 1b had dropped, a running group move now
also locks Change folder… (new "moving" refusal, en and es), and
activeTransactionDeps uses busyNow so relocate sees the move lock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
